exercises.why: **выбираю** — выбира́ть (imperfective): to choose, to select, to pick, to pick out; to elect; to take out, to pick out, to remove; (nautical) to haul in (a net, rope, or hawser), to pull up (an anchor). Wiktionary: вы- + -бира́ть.
